The '''Bamasia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the group known as [[Bamasian]]s.<ref name="BS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bamasia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
